args.body: Start with the committed GETS qualification.json and the original Health NZ notice (TASK-179562096114). Check world mission records for an existing GETS assignment or completed verdict and reuse it. The original returned HTTP 200 and its heading describes an electronic wayfinding solution. Verify whether the buyer expressly invites a separately quotable offline data or documentation deliverable. If that scope is absent, preserve the decisive wording. Use the committed index only as a pointer to one stronger original if the title or lot indicates a discrete offline deliverable and no existing mission allowance would be exceeded. For a verified fit, run passing and failing fictional controls against one actual acceptance clause and prepare a private AI-disclosed quote with provisional price, currency, delivery effort, exact operator submission step and payment conditions. Otherwise preserve the bounded result and the first-party evidence that would reopen it. Read back any saved result and include a lesson if closing an owned mission under a valid lease. No external submission, spending or deployment.
